assign.now: built four Servex in-process tools (page_add, page_set, page_log, page_read) over Item.Store, Servex/agents/page_tools.js

decision.question: how does page_read compute state without a browser (no DOM in Servex)
options: import core/Page/Log.js's real Item/PageLog classes into node
write a small, deliberately partial replay just for title/content/log
decision.chose: a small partial replay (parse_lines + replay() in page_tools.js)
decision.why: Log.js and Item.js are browser classes (View imports, crypto.randomUUID assumed global — fine in node 24, but View/LiveList pull in DOM-adjacent code); importing them into Servex risked breaking core's own no-DOM-in-node guarantee for a feature that only needs title/content/log, not full rendering. Verified against a live page_read call through the real Servex MCP door.

log.msg: added format:"html" to page_read on the owner's follow-up ask (content-only HTML, no nav chrome) — both formats computed fresh from the same replay(), never stored

added a fifth tool, page_note(path,text,{to}), on the owner's follow-up ask: a `note` line on page.jsonl, read by core/Page/ext/Inbox with no Servex dependency (unlike the older drop/inbox: shape, which needs Servex's HTTP /api/inbox). Servex sends only a short WAKE, never the note text (law 7: no second copy). Old drop/clear/inbox tools untouched, kept for one release.
